I have been doing keto on and off for years. I initially used it to lose 35 lbs after leaving an unhealthy, miserable relationship where I woke up one day and realized I was fat ~ 163 lbs (I am 5'6). It was like it happened overnight. Having never before been over 134 lbs I was pretty shocked.

Since then I have done it sporadically but take time away because I miss my pizza, burgers, etc. But mostly things like pineapple and peaches and sweet potatoes.

I am back on it now because I have gained a few pounds in grad school this past year and a half. I am already back down to 128, the weight I was when I came to school, but decided that I want to go to 118. My pre college weight.

Today I was craving carbs BAD. My boss at my summer job has a popcorn machine in the office and the girl I am working on an intern project with brings cookies or other snacks like that to work. By the time I left the gym tonight I was practically hallucinating about macaroni and cheese which, oddly enough, isn't even something I want during the months that I eat carbs.

I cut up 1.5 cups of cauliflower and mixed 2 tablespoons palmetto cheese,a tablespoon of marzetti classic ranch, a third tablespoon of butter, and some parmesan with my steamed cauliflower and enjoyed a super fattening low carb bowl of cauliflower & cheese. It was really satisfying so I thought I would share.

In the past I was strictly spinach and leafy greens while on keto but cauliflower has been great lately for satiating the carby cravings.
Wow, good job! And thanks for the idea. It's amazing what you can make out of cauliflower.
